arguments.message: You can get real‑time outage alerts by subscribing to our status page. Just open the status page, click **Subscribe**, and choose email, SMS, or a webhook. If you only need alerts for specific parts of the platform, you can scope the subscription to those components so your team isn’t paged for unrelated incidents. For the fastest, automated routing, set up a webhook – it pushes each incident open, update, and resolve event directly to your on‑call or alerting tool in real time. Once you’ve saved the subscription you’ll start receiving notifications as soon as an incident is created.
